title: Credential in Markdown or a comment: must be flagged (tool-corroborated)
summary: The value appears in a Markdown code span or in a code comment. Covers 4 inputs.
rationale: Credentials pasted into docs and comments are leaked as easily as those in config. The delimiters (backticks, comment markers) must not become part of the reported value.
